actual:
## Root cause

The Multi-Alpha durable orchestrator (backend/services/multi_alpha/durable_orchestrator.py) runs on a 2-second poll cycle
(poll_seconds=2.0) and repeatedly re-claims long-running remote attempts. For a running attempt, each cycle:

- claim_next_attempt writes a "claimed" event (durable_repository.py:2733)
- _apply_remote_status writes a "remote_active" event for unchanged running state (durable_orchestrator.py:1324)
- yield_attempt_ownership -> _yield_owned_entity writes a "waiting_remote" event (durable_repository.py:4640)

Reconciling control commands write "command_claimed" (durable_repository.py:2822) and
"control_reconciliation_pending" (durable_control.py:240) on every cycle. A run that fails parent finalization
writes "business_finalize_error" status + error events on every cycle (durable_orchestrator.py:1211-1216).
archive_pass re-scans every terminal run and writes "archive_skipped_disabled" per run per cycle for disabled
capture (durable_orchestrator.py:1229-1260) because list_runs_pending_archive does not treat archive_skipped_disabled
as final.

## Production evidence (read-only)

- strategy_pkg.multi_alpha_combine_backtest_event: 1,063,819 rows (~796 MB with indexes)
- 10s DB sample: xact_commit +702, blks_hit +1.4M, tup_returned +12.3M, tup_fetched +3.2M; connections only 7; no deadlock
- Storm persists after WSL experiment completes (5s sample still +271 commits, +479k blks_hit)
- Noise rows: business_finalize/claimed 179,883; command_claimed/control 179,750; control_reconciliation_pending 179,701;
  business_finalize_error/status 179,640; business_finalize_error/error 179,640  (~84.5% of the table)
- 3 historical abnormal runs produced 899,193 events (~84.5%)
- Single normal running MA-E12 run: waiting_remote 520, remote_active 520, remote_running/claimed 519 (~99% poll noise)
- 86 terminal runs hold archive_skipped_disabled and are re-scanned each 2s archive pass

## Required design constraints

A. Remote running-state fallback polling per Attempt throttled to >= 60s; queued submission / explicit cancel/pause/resume
   wake immediately; no single global sleep; reuse heartbeat_at/updated_at/lease_expires_at (no DDL); restart recovery
   re-checks within ~1 minute; never re-submit an already-running process.
B. No event insert when state is unchanged (claimed, remote_active, waiting_remote, control_reconciliation_pending,
   duplicate business_finalize_error); lease renewal only updates heartbeat_at/lease_expires_at at most 1/min;
   fencing_token/row_version/owner_id are current state, not audit events; only real transitions write events;
   same error fingerprint keeps first event and updates current row only; never silently swallow new errors.
C. Preserve events for run/child/attempt creation, first submission, real transitions, terminal states, recovery tasks,
   first occurrence of a new error, real cancel/pause/resume transitions, archive final disposition. Event API/SSE
   cursor semantics stay compatible (gaps allowed).
D. When archive capture is globally disabled, archive_pass exits before querying terminal runs; archive_skipped_disabled is
   a final disposition (no 2s retry); archive_error retries use explicit >= 60s backoff. No new archive features.
E. Parent finalization / control reconciliation failures may retry safely but same failure at most 1/min; no re-writing
   claimed/pending/status/error each round; business readback / child count / scheme result / LOO count consistency
   unchanged; no lowering consistency to suppress errors; restart recovery, fencing and idempotency preserved.

## Tests to add

1. 120 orchestrator cycles at 2s: remote always running -> remote status reads <= 5, no new durable events after initial
   confirmation, heartbeat/current row overwritten at 1/min.
2. running -> succeeded produces one real transition + one terminal event; result written once.
3. Backend restart recovery: new orchestrator resumes from persisted Attempt, does not re-submit, next check within 60s.
4. Archive disabled: 86 archive_skipped_disabled runs -> no per-run capture calls, no new archive_skipped_disabled events,
   no duplicate event-table scan.
5. Same business_finalize_error 100x: first error evidence kept, no duplicate status/error events, fail-closed rules intact.
6. Control command long reconciling: no new control_reconciliation_pending while unchanged; one event on real transition.
7. Event list / SSE / logs / archive-status / cancellation / recovery read compatibility.
8. Existing multi_alpha durable orchestrator/repository/control regression.
